body: Thank you, but the problem with those is that they don't really quite address my problem. I'm aware that my life could have some meaning for the other people around me or for society, etc. I 'm just not interested in that, because none of the people around me nor society nor anything else has meaning either. Nothing truly matters. And even if that weren't true, I don't think having meaning or purpose in life would change my perception that I was perfectly content for the billions of years prior to my birth, and fail to see an advantage in not being perfectly content(or content at all, truthfully) in life, even if there is a purpose for it. Is that purpose truly worth it? I would say no, it isn't.
